source_notes: PR=0:no credited laboratory practicals.Three syllabus-suggested projects and three activities retained without fabricated readings/visits or invented report-page requirements.
Derivations direct and ordered;minimal necessary assumptions/explanation.Numericals given-find-formula-substitution-answer-check.4/7marks are suggested study depths,not official marks for each topic.
STP/NTP numerical conventions always declared;Raoult liquid fractions distinguished from vapour fractions;Henry constant convention stated.
Antoine numerical uses explicitly hypothetical teaching constants,not actual compound/Perry data.Handbook project requires a genuine cited lookup.
Operations balances use stated mass/molar,moisture and retention assumptions.No unnecessary equipment-construction load added.
